name: hell_mode_bring_it
about: Hell Mode story Short: a bored gamer calls every game weaksauce, finds the Hell Mode difficulty - 'you shall be faced with utter despair' - and says bring it; the drop opens on the red eye igniting into his summons tearing through monsters, and he ends announcing he is a Summoner.
anime: Hell Mode: The Hardcore Gamer Dominates in Another World with Garbage Balancing

story.why: gamer: hot garbage, gimme one that takes 10 years to beat
there's a Hell Mode? utter despair... bring it!

outro.why: Allen: power from Lord Elmea himself - I'm a summoner

title: Bored Gamer Picks HELL MODE And Gets Reborn As The Weakest Class
hook: Every game was too easy for him. So he chose Hell Mode - 100x the EXP to level up, born a serf, and the class nobody picks.
